question: For each course, list its name, name of the building of the course location, and the cumulative number of courses, including the course itself, held in the same year or preceding years (partitioned by academic year and sorted in the ascending order of course start date).

    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,

    at.TERM_START_DATE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE

cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.subject_count, cte1.total_units, cte2.total_units AS dept_total_units, cte2.num_courses_latest_year FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms AS pts JOIN AcademicYearStats AS ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY END AS SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, CASE WHEN GROUPING(COURSE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COURSE END AS COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG`) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units) SELECT s1.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, s1.COURSE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.total_units, s2.total_units AS department_total_units, s2.num_courses_latest_year FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), TermInfo AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), DeptSubjects AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cco ON t0.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_PARAMETER, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TermInfo AS t ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(d.num_subjects) FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_CODE

WITH student_info AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t1 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict'), top_departments AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3), top_departments_undergrad_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM top_departments AS ic JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.window_column, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS student_admin_department_name, tduc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tduc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department_name, tduc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_admin_department_name, tduc.num_undergrad_courses FROM student_info AS si JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = si.DEPARTMENT JOIN top_departments_undergrad_courses AS tduc ON tduc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = si.DEPARTMENT

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.window_column, s1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, s1.IS_REGULAR_TERM, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.benchmark_enrollment, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), top_departments AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6'), kevin_courses AS (SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS inner_cte JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON inner_cte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.SCHOOL_NAME, td.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, td.num_subjects, td.avg_enrollment, kc.FULL_NAME, kc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, kc.STUDENT_YEAR, kc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, kc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, kc.COURSE_LEVEL, kc.window_column, kc.SUBJECT_CODE, kc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM top_departments AS td JOIN kevin_courses AS kc ON td.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = kc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AND td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = kc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) ORDER BY td.num_subjects DESC, kc.FULL_NAME

'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_START_DATE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1)
)
SELECT
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_courses
FROM base
ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, SUBJECT_TITLE;
